chapter.verse: Pasian’ Tapa Zeisu Khazih’ Lungdamna Thu a kipatna in hih bang hi.
Kamsang Isaiah’ Lai Siangtho sungah: “En in, na pai nading lam sial ding, Na mai-ah ka sawltakpa ka paisak ding hi.
Gampa lakah a kikopa’ aw in, ‘Topa paina lam na sial un, Ama lampi na tangsak un,’ a ci hi,” ci-in kigelh hi.
Johan hong kilang a, gampa lakah baptaiz a, mawh kimaisak nadingin, mawhna kisik kikna thu leh baptaizna thu a hilh hi.
Jerusalem khuapihte akipan Judah gamah a om mi khempeuhte in ama kiangah va pai uh a, amau mawhna pulakin ama khut tungah, Jordan gun sungah a kibaptaiz uh hi.
Johan in kala-oh mul kigan puan silh a, savun kawnggak in a kawng a gak hi. Kauphe leh gamlak khuaizu-in kivak hi.
Ama thuhilhna in, “Kei sangin a lian zawpa khat in ka nungah hong pai ding hi. Ama khedap khau sut ding nangawn ka kilawm kei hi.
Keimah in note tui sungah kong baptaiz hi. Amah in Kha Siangtho sungah note hong baptaiz ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in Galile gam Nazareth khua panin va pai a, Johan khut tungah Jordan gun sungah a kibaptaiz hi.
Thakhat a, tui sung pan a thawhtoh lai takin van kihong a, Kha Siangtho in vakhu bangin ama tungah hong kumsuk a mu hi.
“Nang in ka lung hong damsak ka it ka Tapa na hi hi,” ci-in vantung panin aw khat a ging hi.
Tua ciangin, Kha Siangtho in Zeisu gampa lakah a sawl pah hi.
Gampa lakah ni sawmli omin, Satan’ khemna thuak a, gampa lak ganhingte tawh omkhawm a; vantungmite in a vak uh hi.
Johan a kimat khit ciangin Zeisu Galile gamah pai a, Pasian’ Lungdamna Thu a hilh-inah,
“A hun a kicing zo hi. Pasian Gam a hong nai zo hi. Na mawhna kisikkik un la, Lungdamna Thu na um ta un,” a ci hi.
Galile tuili gei lamah a pai lai takin, Simon leh Andru te unau, ngabengte ahih uh ciangin tui sungah ngen paai a om uh a mu hi.
Zeisu in, “Ka nung hong zui un. Mi mante kong suaksak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Amaute in thakhatin a ngen uh nusia-in Zeisu nung a zui uh hi.
A tomkha a pai khit ciangin, Zebedi’ tate Jakob leh a nau Johan zong gunkuang sungah ngen khui-a om a muh ciangin thakhatin a sap leh,
amaute in gunkuang sungah thacialte tawh a pa Zebedi nusia-in Zeisu nung a zui uh hi.
Amaute Kapernaum khua-ah lut uh a, Nipi ni-in Zeisu kikhopna inn sungah thakhatin lut a, thu a hilh hi.
Amaute in ama thuhilhna lamdang a sa uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, amah in laitheite bangin a hilh kei hi, ukpa bangin thu a hilh hi.
Amaute’ kikhopna inn sungah thakhatin kihhuai dawi lut mi khat a om hi.
“Nazareth mi Zeisu aw, kote in nang tawh bang kikum i hi hiam? Kote susia dingin hong pai na hi hiam? Nang kua mi na hih ke’n kong thei hi. Pasian’ mi siangtho na hi hi,” ci-in a kiko hi.
Zeisu in, “Pau kei in la, ama sung pan paikhia in,” ci-in a taai hi.
Kihhuai dawi in tua pa a kongkawsak khit ciangin nakpi-in kiko a, ama sung pan a paikhia hi.

Mi khempeuhte in lamdang a sa uh a, “Hih thu in bang thu ahi hiam? Thuhilhna thak ahi hiam? Uk neihna tawh kihhuai dawite thu a piak ciangin amau in a thu a mang uh hi,” ci-in khat leh khat a kikum uh hi.
Thakhatin ama thu in Galile gam sung khempeuh kizeel hi.
Kikhopna inn sung pan a paikhiat khit uh ciangin Simon leh Andrute’ inn sungah Jakob leh Johan tawh thakhatin a tum uh hi.
Simon’ sungnu nattun’a, lumin a om hi. Amau in thakhatin Zeisu a ko uh hi.
Zeisu in va nai a, tua numei khut len a, a phot leh, a nattun’ dam a, zinte a vak hi.
Ni tum a, nitak ciangin cinatna a vei khempeuh leh a sungah dawi lutte Zeisu kiangah paipih uh a;
khua zangpi-in kongkhak kiangah a kikhawm uh hi.
Zeisu in cinatna nam tuamtuam a vei tampi damsak a, dawi tampi a hawlkhia hi. Dawite in Zeisu a theih manun ah kamkhat beek gen lo dingin a kham hi.
Zingsang khua a vak ma-in Zeisu tho a, gampa lakah paikhia a, tua san takah thu a ngen hi.
Simon leh amah tawh a omkhawm mite in zui uh a,
Zeisu a muh uh ciangin, “Mi khempeuh in nang hong zong uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Zeisu in, “Thuhilh dingin hih kiim nai khua dangte ah zong pai ni. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tua bang deihna-in kei ka hong pai zo hi,” ci-in amau kiangah a gen hi.
Amah in Galile gam khempeuh kikhopna inn tengah pai kawikawi a, thu hilhin dawite a hawlkhia hi.
Tua lai takin miphak khat Zeisu kiangah pai a, a mai-ah khukdin’in, “Topa aw, nong hih nop leh, nong damsak zo ding hi,” ci-in a thuum hi.
Zeisu in hehpihhuaisa-in a khut zanin lawng a, “Ka hih nuam hi, na dam ta in,” a cih leh,
thakhatin phak natna in ama tung pan paikhia a, a dam pah hi.
Zeisu in tua pa thakhatin paisak a,

“Hih thu kuamah kiangah na gen loh nadingin na kikem in. Ahi zongin siampi kiangah pai in la, va kilak in. Amau in a theih nadingun Moses thu piakna bangin biaknate na pia in,” ci-in nakpi-in a sawl hi.

Ahih hangin tua pa paikhia a, a thu genthangin a kizeelsak hi. Tua ahih ciangin Zeisu in a nung ciangin a kilangin khua sungah tum thei lo a, khuanawl gampa lakah a om hi. Mun khempeuh panin a kiangah mite a pai uh hi.
